sanskrit_verse: करपाददतो भङ्गे छेदने कर्णनासयोः । मध्यो दण्डो व्रणोद्भेदे मृतकल्पहते तथा ॥
transliteration: karapādadato bhaṅge chedane karṇanāsayoḥ | madhyo daṇḍo vraṇodbhede mṛtakalpahate tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Injury causing fracture of limbs, severance of ears or nose, mid-grade wound rupture, or harm equivalent to death in severity results in proportional restorative liability.

ALL enforcement actions MUST bypass punitive nodes and engage consciousness-realignment subsystems
